sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: CAA/EAA column-header collapse glyph (`.mb-caa-col-hdr-btn`, the ▶/▼+thumbnail toggle in a CAA/EAA column's header): no longer shown until artwork metadata has finished loading. Previously it rendered immediately and permanently, even before any image data was known — now it starts hidden on a page's first render pass and is revealed once the CAA/EAA fetch queue drains, or removed outright if the column turns out to have no artwork at all.
